about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: My professional journey and achievements
about.p1: I am Rovshen Rejepbayevich Ashirov, a Backend Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience. I graduated from Tashkent University of Information Technologies Urgench branch and currently work as a Backend Software Engineer at UZINFOCOM.
about.p2: Throughout my career at companies like UZINFOCOM and Perspective Team, I have successfully built national-level platforms including EnergoNazorat, ScienceID, ScienceGate, Anjumanlar, Plagiat.uz, SLIB.uz, ROI.uz. These platforms serve 10,000+ users.
about.p3: Key achievements: implementing OAuth2 protocol in Django DRF, integration with OneID system, supporting platforms with 35,000+ scientific articles, and building complex systems based on microservices architecture.
about.p4: Technologies: extensive experience with Django, Laravel, Yii2, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, OAuth2, Microservices and other modern technologies.
